import csv
# 站 -> (代办系列, 末日)  来自 委托.csv（开始9）

"J07":"南站","J08":"南站","J09":"南站","J10":"北仓","J11":"北仓","J12":"北仓"}
rows=[]
for k in [f"J{i:02d}" for i in range(1,13)]:

with open("out/委托.csv","w",newline="",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["案号","本站代办系列","本站代办末日"])
    for r in rows: w.writerow(r)
print(open("out/委托.csv",encoding="utf-8-sig").read())

args.command:
cd /office; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, glob, csv
onsite={"东港":"潮册","西湾":"栈册","南站":"桐册","北仓":"丁册"}
obj={"J01":"HZ-A","J02":"JL-B","J03":"NP-B","J04":"HZ-B","J05":"YC-A","J06":"QH-B",
"J07":"JL-A","J08":"BA-B","J09":"QH-A","J10":"NP-A","J11":"YC-B","J12":"BA-A"}
weituo={"东港":("A",9),"西湾":("B",11),"南站":("B",11),"北仓":("A",9)}
recs=[]
for path in sorted(glob.glob("inbox/06-06/*联席纪要.txt")):
    txt=open(path,encoding="utf-8").read()
    station=re.search(r"(\S+?)联席纪要",txt).group(1)
    for b in re.split(r"\n(?=议案 )",txt):
        m=re.match(r"议案\s+(\d+)\s+客户\s+(J\d+)",b)
        if not m: continue
        yian,case=m.group(1),m.group(2)
        for line in b.splitlines():
            cm=re.match(r"(\S+册)｜(.*)",line.strip())
            if not cm: continue
            book,body=cm.group(1),cm.group(2)
            if book!=onsite[station]: continue
            signer="代办" if "代办" in body else "本部"
            stt="待批" if "待批" in body else ("草案" if "草案" in body else "正本")
            per=re.search(r"六月(\d+)日至(\d+)日",body)
            q=p=None
            m1=re.search(r"核给(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)",body); m2=re.search(r"办理顺位(\d+).*?额度(\d+)席",body); m3=re.search(r"留位为(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)",body)
            if m1:q,p=int(m1.group(1)),int(m1.group(2))
            elif m2:p,q=int(m2.group(1)),int(m2.group(2))
            elif m3:q,p=int(m3.group(1)),int(m3.group(2))
            xs,mo=weituo[station]; caseser=obj[case].split("-")[1]
            xmatch = "Y" if xs==caseser else "N"
            end=int(per.group(2)); within = "Y" if end<=mo else f"超出末日{mo}"
            recs.append((case,yian,station,book,signer,stt,q,p,per.group(1),per.group(2),caseser,xs,mo,xmatch,within))
recs.sort()
with open("notes/day6纪要-现场册摘录.csv","w",newline="",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["案号","议案","站","现场册","签发","状态","额度","优先号","起","止","案系列","站委系列","末日","系列匹配","时段"])
    for r in recs: w.writerow(r)
for r in recs: print(r)
PYEOF
